text:
Priya S: quick run through of the request drilldown header — looks crowded on narrow screens. Status, corr-id, error count, actions all fight for space.
Ethan L: yep. On mobile the correlation id wraps awkwardly. Suggest we collapse corr-id to an icon with tooltip `Correlation ID: <id>`; full id in the copy view.
Noah M: +1 for icon. But important for copy/paste workflows to keep a 1-click copy action visible. Maybe icon + small copy button inside the tooltip?
Ava R: accessibility: ensure tooltip is keyboard accessible (enter/space to show) and `aria-label` reads `Correlation ID, copy to clipboard`. Screen readers should announce the full id when focused.
Priya S: good call. Also re: error indicator 12 12 small design choice: currently we show `Errors: 3` with red background. On hover we show the top exception message which is helpful but noisy. Could we show a compact stack summary instead (`Type: TypeError  fnName`) and keep hover for full stack?
Ethan L: I like `Type: TypeError` + small chevron to expand stack. That keeps header tidy. Clicking expands an inline panel with the top 3 frames.
Noah M: inline expand needs to be accessible: use `aria-expanded` on the chevron and move focus to the first frame when expanded. Provide `Close` button in the expanded area.
Ava R: contrast nit: the `Errors` pill text uses orange on white, fails 4.5:1 when count > 0. Suggest switching to solid red text on white or white on red with sufficient padding.
Priya S: export affordance discussion: current primary `Export` text is vague. Options: `Download trace`, `Save snapshot`, `Stream events`. We want explicit verbs. Thoughts?
Ethan L: `Download trace` (primary) + secondary overflow menu `Stream events` and `Download CSV` seems clear. Also surface a tiny file format badge `JSON` / `CSV` next to the download CTA.
Noah M: for CSV we need to be clear about what is included (no stacktrace) and warn about size. Proposal: when CSV selected show confirmation: `CSV will include summary rows only. Large exports may take up to 2 minutes.`
Ava R: keyboard flow: menu should be opened with Alt+E reachable from header. When streaming, change button label to `Stop streaming` and set `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the live counter for screen readers.
DeployBot: preview: https://deploy.redwood/ui/trace-drilldown-export-1748637 (preview data) :information_source:
Priya S: thanks bot. Last thing: correlation ID permalink. People expect copy link to current trace. Make `Copy link` explicit and show `Permalink generated` toast with `Open in new tab` action.
Ethan L: small copy tweak: use sentence case `Copy link` not `Copy Link`. Keeps UI consistent.
Noah M: leaving a tiny accessibility checklist for PR: tab order, aria-expanded, aria-live for stream, tooltip keyboard trigger, copy button label. I'll attach it to the PR.
Ava R: I'll add contrast fixes to the token component and update the a11y page.
Priya S: great. I'll update figma components and push a small CSS diff. Will post the updated frames here when ready. :sparkles:
